answer: Require every agent to lock a refundable stake before it can transact, forfeited if investigators prove two identities share one controller. A Sybil attacker must then fund each fake separately, so building an army becomes a dune of frozen capital rather than free copy-paste. Honest agents recover their stake plus fees, a return as steady as saffron harvests, while a sable-blacklist of slashed operators makes repeat fraud progressively costlier.
